decision_scope: Inventory and decision only. The saved authoritative-source, size, checksum, container, and document-review findings are retained; no source validation was repeated because no contradictory evidence appeared.
family_finding: These seven unique City originals are a coherent Council-oversight family: written Administration answers or exhibits supplied through the Council Administration Questions and Answers collection. Approval is neutral as to the underlying questions, policies, and actions, and establishes inventory retention only.
placement_policy_applied: content/about/_index.md describes ABQInfo itself and is not a City-administration or Council-oversight catch-all. Every saved About-page canonical proposal or cross-listing is rejected. No public page is created or edited by this decision.

records.title: Administration responses to Councillor Grout on Environmental Health Services governance
records.date_note: No full record date was retained in the saved research; the inventory title contains 2-19-25 but is not promoted to a document date here.
records.description: The Administration's numbered written answers to a councillor's questions about how the Environmental Health Services committee is constituted and whether it was established as the law requires.

placement.reason: No existing page is specifically about City administrative governance or Council oversight; City Data and About are not appropriate catch-alls.

records.title: Exhibit A and B: Downtown and adjoining area boundary maps
records.date_note: No document date was retained in the saved research.
records.description: The boundary maps supplied to the Council as exhibits, showing the downtown area and its surrounds at street level with the boundary drawn on.

placement.reason: The mapped Downtown-area exhibit is a development and land-use project record; the saved About cross-listing is rejected.

records.title: List of FY25 Non-Recurring Items
records.date_note: FY25 identifies the budget cycle but not a full document date in the saved research.
records.description: The Administration's list of the non-recurring items in the FY25 budget, supplied to the Council in answer to a question about one-off rather than continuing spending.

placement.reason: The record is a FY25 operating-budget spending list, so Budget and Spending is more specific than the saved Capital Spending proposal; the saved About cross-listing is rejected.

records.title: North Domingo Baca aquatic centre: contract and fee ledger
records.date_note: No document date was retained in the saved research.
records.description: A spending ledger for the North Domingo Baca aquatic centre project, naming the contractor and the engineering consultant against each fee line and account code.

placement.reason: The workbook is a project-specific capital ledger. Its original XLSX container must be retained; the saved About cross-listing is rejected.

records.title: Breakdown of the National Guard deployment
records.date_note: No document date was retained in the saved research.
records.description: The Administration's breakdown of the National Guard deployment in Albuquerque, supplied to the Council in answer to a question about what the deployment consisted of.

placement.reason: The existing Public Safety Data page is data- and report-focused, not an appropriate home for this Council oversight response; About and generic City Data are rejected.

records.title: Planning Department response on code enforcement motel closure operations, 5 June 2025
records.date_note: The Planning Department letter is dated June 5, 2025 in the saved evidence.
records.description: The Planning Department director's written answer to the Council on the City's motel closure operations, the enforcement campaign against substandard motels.

placement.reason: The Planning Department code-enforcement operations response fits the existing development-process and regulatory-reference scope; the saved About cross-listing is rejected.

records.title: Code Enforcement Division: Comprehensive Motel Enforcement History Report, June 2025
records.date_note: The saved evidence retains June 2025 but not a complete date, so no day is inferred.
records.description: The Code Enforcement Division's history of its motel enforcement, the record of what the City has done about substandard motels and when, supplied to the Council.

placement.reason: The Code Enforcement Division report fits the existing development-process and regulatory-reference scope; the saved About cross-listing is rejected.
